Help Desk > Anonymous tab: ticked 'Allow anonymous posts in this space' + save -> 'Anonymous posting settings saved.', settings JSON {"allow_anonymous":true}. With extra keys {keepme, seo:{...}} in the JSON, unticking + save -> {"allow_anonymous":false,"keepme":"yes","seo":{...}}: merged, other keys survive, false (not removed). Screenshot anon-tab.png.

As a guest: topic page has 0 occurrences of 'Bob Martinez', '/u/bob/' and 'bob.demo', byline 'Anonymous'; Help Desk listing card for it has no name, no /u/ link, no avatar image (window around the title). Screenshot anon-topic.png.
